name: bbm-mods

plugins.name: ci-preflight
plugins.description: Runs the fast CI checks (schema-drift, portal selftests, migration lints, workflow pins) before a git push leaves the session; refuses update-branch while checks fail or run; warns on repeat pushes within 10 minutes; labels the open PR with its risk tier after a push (labels only, nothing enforced).

plugins.name: fleet-tracker
plugins.description: Live dashboard of cloud sessions an orchestrator spins up, with wake-ups on blocked/failed/review/done.

plugins.name: draft-session
plugins.description: v2_s6 Draft session guard: contract injected from the refresh-agent file, draft-lint on /draft-done, Draft receipt blocked until lint passes; cloud sessions pin with draft_pin and get the credentialed CI lint.

plugins.name: run-state
plugins.description: Band with the refresh run's stage, next READY section, Pass A age and missing receipts, plus a guard that refuses receipt writes for sections the conductor has not marked READY (asks when the plan is unreadable).

plugins.name: session-close
plugins.description: Lists the close-out obligations a session left unmet (INGEST, Jira comment, run state, scheduled checkpoints, Pass verdicts) on /close-out or a wrap-up turn.

plugins.name: refresh-run-guard
plugins.description: Guards the refresh run: denies hand-written receipts and Bash publish paths, tracks Pass A freshness, checks Webflow item payloads.

plugins.name: jira-closer
plugins.description: When a session merges a PR, arms auto-merge or hands it to the merge queue (marks it ready or adds the queue / merge-train label), makes it update the PR's Jira ticket (Done after a merge, a state comment while queued); blocks the turn's end once while a ticket is untouched.

plugins.name: pillar-brief-guard
plugins.description: Enforces the pillar-brief rules in any session: article ideas name a parent article, product selection and new article files need an approved (<= 365 days) brief, approvals name an approver.

plugins.name: prod-deploy-guard
plugins.description: Refuses production deploys and DDL from a session (MCP deploy_edge_function, wrangler/supabase CLI deploys, DDL via execute_sql); apply_migration asks. GitHub is production (LC-421).

plugins.name: bulk-write-guard
plugins.description: Refuses Supabase execute_sql writes that do not prove, in their own text, that they touch 5 rows or fewer; larger writes go through a data-changes/ package (LC-1683).

plugins.name: spend-delete-ask
plugins.description: Asks the operator before any tool that moves money, spends a balance or deletes something a session cannot restore (Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks, link carts, Roominate, Airtable/Notion/Drive/GitHub/Cloudflare/Supabase deletes).

plugins.name: no-ask-in-child
plugins.description: Denies AskUserQuestion in a cloud session another session created (parent_session_id set): no human is watching it. Unreadable signal = allow.

plugins.name: no-browser-as-me
plugins.description: Refuses driving the operator's own browser or desktop: the chrome-browser / computer-use skills and any Chrome or computer-use MCP server.

plugins.name: recurring-successor-guard
plugins.description: Refuses closing a recurring Jira ticket (label `recurring` or a 'next due' line) until the session created its successor ticket or scheduled task.

plugins.name: reply-footer-check
plugins.description: Blocks a turn's end once when the reply's last line is not `Noted separately: <keys>` / `Nothing`, or names a ticket no Jira call touched.

plugins.name: investigation-log
plugins.description: Blocks a turn's end once when the session read page-level analytics 3+ times (GSC page tables, rank watch, SERP tools, live page fetches) but logged no page investigation.

plugins.name: knowledge-superseded-check
plugins.description: After a read of knowledge_memories / knowledge_articles, names superseded rows and their replacements, and nudges a query that skips is_active / superseded_by.

plugins.name: session-title-nudge
plugins.description: Puts the session-naming convention (`<TICKET> — <summary>`) in front of the model at session start, and a rename reminder when createJiraIssue mints a key.

plugins.name: oversized-file-nudge
plugins.description: Advisory only: on an Edit/Write to a source file already over 1,500 lines, reminds the session to extract the touched job into its own module instead of growing the file (LC-1983).

plugins.name: correction-needs-check
plugins.description: Advisory only: when a session writes down a correction (lesson/preference memory, CLAUDE.md 'Why this rule exists' block, skill rule, feedback memory file) with no 'Enforced by:' or 'Not checkable because:' line, asks it to name the check or the reason (LC-2151).

plugins.name: skill-copy-guard
plugins.description: Refuses edits to .claude/skills/ byte copies; skills change in brand-bridge-media/claude-skills, and the mirror brings them here.

plugins.name: dispatch-watch
plugins.description: After a session dispatches a workflow through the github-dispatch bridge, checks the run every minute and wakes the session when it finishes, fails to start, or runs long; flags a finish under 2 minutes as the did-nothing shape.

plugins.name: pr-ci-watch
plugins.description: After a git push or create_pull_request, checks the branch's PR every 2 minutes and wakes the session once its CI has finished, so a session never depends on GitHub's PR events alone; after auto-merge is armed it watches until the merge and wakes if green but not merged within 30 minutes, naming why.

plugins.name: refresh-start-path-guard
plugins.description: Denies starting refresh-run.yml any way but the github-dispatch bridge, so dispatch-watch follows every refresh run (LC-1902, LC-1975).

plugins.name: workflow-run-watch
plugins.description: After a GitHub MCP actions_run_trigger start or re-run, polls the run every minute and wakes the session when it finishes (flagging a finish under 2 minutes), never registers, or runs long.

plugins.name: unwatched-job-guard
plugins.description: In a session another session created, refuses to end a turn while a job it started is unfinished and no watcher mod or check-in holds it.

plugins.name: idle-backstop-guard
plugins.description: Refuses to end a turn while the session has open fleet children or watcher items and no server-side check-in (send_later / create_trigger) fires within 35 minutes: the in-process timers that watch them stop while the session idles (LC-2043). Fails open; child sessions get a toast only.

plugins.name: supabase-guard
plugins.description: Supabase exposure rules before SQL runs or a migration is written (execute_sql, apply_migration, migration-file Write/Edit): blocks a table without RLS, a view without security_invoker, an unrevoked or search_path-less SECURITY DEFINER, and an unmarked GRANT to anon/authenticated; warns on a function without search_path. Same rules as the lint-supabase-rules PR gate.

plugins.name: image-weight-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Webflow CMS item writes and asset uploads that load an image over 400 KB or not WebP/AVIF/SVG (HEAD check before the image is loaded); asks when size or type cannot be determined. Fix: route through generated-image-intake (LC-1883).

plugins.name: mod-freshness
plugins.description: Warns a long-lived session, once per mod, when a mod it loaded at start has since changed in the bbm-mods mirror, so the operator knows to start a fresh session.

plugins.name: where-we-stand
plugins.description: When a session starts diagnosing a recurring problem or is about to state a ticket's or article's status, looks the topic up read-only (knowledge, Jira newest comment, GitHub, production) and injects one card: know / state / verified | not verified | conflict. Once per topic, three per session.

plugins.name: child-model-guard
plugins.description: A create_session call must name its model: denies a missing or empty model, asks before a top-tier (opus/fable) child unless the brief names a design judgment.

plugins.name: refresh-status
plugins.description: Types "refresh status" and gets the Overseer's per-stage table for every monitored refresh, injected to be shown verbatim. NOT CHECKED if the read fails; never invents a row.

plugins.name: slowness-report
plugins.description: Puts a clock on every PR a session opens or arms for auto-merge; past a 30-minute budget it wakes the session once to measure where the time went, then records ONE dated occurrence comment (with the PR reference) on the ticket that owns that cause under epic LCH-600. Never creates a ticket: recurrence is the comment count per cause. /slow does the same on the operator's demand.

plugins.name: jira-epic-guard
plugins.description: Refuses to create a Jira issue in project LC without a parent epic (Epic and Sub-task exempt) and lists the live epics to choose from; a parked epic as parent is refused too. The epic list is data (hooks/epics.json). Fails open.

plugins.name: t2-evidence-fill
plugins.description: When a session opens or edits a T2 pull request on bbm-infrastructure, inserts the ## Evidence section if missing, fills Tests from the counts of the session's own test runs, and refuses to mark the PR ready while a slot is empty (LC-2156). Slots and judge are read from scripts/ci/t2_evidence.*. Fails open.

plugins.name: lch600-review-gate
plugins.description: Refuses to open a PR that changes CI, CD, deploy or test-runner files (path list is data: hooks/paths.json) until the session has asked LCH-600 for review in Jira, read its [LCH-600 feedback] comment and answered it, or recorded a skip with a reason. LCH tickets are exempt. Fails open.

plugins.name: pipeline-change-nudge
plugins.description: Advisory only: on the first edit in a session to a bbm-infrastructure pipeline file, asks for the PR's Pipeline change statement and a check that no other pipeline change is in flight (LCH-676).

plugins.name: pipeline-close-question
plugins.description: Advisory only: after an LCH ticket is transitioned, reminds the session that a pipeline story closes only with a comment answering whether it will recur and what prevents it now (LCH-676).

description: Claude Code mods (plugins of function hooks) for Brand Bridge Media sessions; sources live in claude-mods/.
